note: MA DCR state park in Sturbridge; some sites perch on a hillside above Walker Pond, which has a campers-only swimming beach and a boat ramp. The park office points campers to dump stations elsewhere. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $17/$54 (2026 table) and 2026 season 5/7-10/11 (both unchanged), no hookups, showers/flush toilets, reservations required, 14-day cumulative summer limit, 60 sites. Changed: max_rig_ft 35 -> 30 (ReserveAmerica per-site max; 31 sites take 24-30 ft, 22 pull-throughs); dump unknown -> false (RA and mass.gov both: no dump station). Note cleaned of field facts.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (stored not waterfront; not changed): ReserveAmerica tags 9 sites 'Near Water' (002, 008, 009, 012, 013, 015, 016, 017, 018, all in loop Sites 1-28) and DCR says 'some sites perched on a hillside adjacent to Walker Pond'. On leaf-off Esri imagery the eastern campground road runs ~50-80 m above the west shore with a wooded strip between; per-site positions are not published, so this needs a site-by-site look.

Pin ~280 m off: the stored pin (42.14662,-72.06067) sits on the park road by the day-use parking lot NE of the campground. Leaf-off imagery shows the campground loops (and the four yurts) on the hillside west of Walker Pond's north end, centred about 42.1448,-72.0632.
